$comment: PHASE A BASELINE — hand-derived, NOT extractor output. The callGraph section is the primary comparison target for Phase 1: diffing a verified extractor against it is how the omission rate gets quantified. This component is nearly the easiest possible case (one method, no local calls), so agreement here proves very little; the value is in establishing the diff procedure before it is applied to something hard.

callGraph.$comment: Trivial graph: a single lifecycle hook calling no other local method. calledBy is empty because the framework invokes it, not other code in this file.

fieldAccess.$comment: Both writes happen inside subscription callbacks declared within ngOnInit, so they are attributed to it. Neither field is read in TypeScript — only in the template.

dependencyUsage.$comment: argTypes is 'any' because params.key comes from an untyped query-parameter bag; the service declares the parameter as string.
queryParams is read as an Observable and subscribed, not read once via snapshot.

$comment_inbound: Empty because no repository-wide index exists yet. This component is reached by route, not rendered by a parent, so inbound edges may legitimately remain empty — but that is unverified.

httpInteractions.$comment: Issued indirectly: the service builds the request, but nothing is sent until this component subscribes. The key travels as a query parameter (activate.service.ts:14).

queryParamsConsumed.name: key
queryParamsConsumed.$comment: Observable access, not snapshot — the component reacts to later changes.

routing.$comment: Route declared at activate.route.ts:5-9 with title 'activate.title' and no access restriction.

streams.$comment: Three behavioral properties matter and are easy to lose in a rewrite: (1) mergeMap does not cancel in-flight work, so concurrent attempts race and the last reply to arrive wins; (2) the error handler terminates the stream permanently, so no later query-param change is acted on; (3) no cancellation is registered, though the framework is understood to complete ActivatedRoute streams on route teardown — asserted, not verified, hence leakRisk 'possible' rather than 'none' or 'likely'.

warnings: Hand-derived baseline. Derived facts (call graph, field access) are unverified approximations.
inboundUnitEdges empty because no repository-wide index exists at this stage.
